the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher begins by asking students to reflect on their prior knowledge about road accidents and disasters. Students share their thoughts and experiences, and the teacher connects this to the topic of the lesson. The teacher then distributes the task cards and explains the activity, and students inspect the tasks. The teacher leads directly into the selected activity.

selected_activity:
Activity: Consensus Problem-Solving Carousel: Competency Level 8.4.4
Approach: Students use consensus problem-solving carousel to explore 'Presents information about road accidents and disasters caused at present.'. Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A group civic proposal, diagram, or public information message.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
